This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Project Overview

forecastdom is an R package providing a unified toolkit for forecast dominance testing. It covers the full taxonomy of forecast evaluation hypotheses — unconditional/conditional, equal/superior — plus encompassing and nested-model tests.

R Package Development Commands

# Load package interactively during development
Rscript -e "devtools::load_all()"

# Generate documentation from roxygen2 comments
Rscript -e "devtools::document()"

# Run all tests
Rscript -e "devtools::test()"

# Run a single test file
Rscript -e "testthat::test_file('tests/testthat/test-cspa_test.R')"

# Full R CMD check
Rscript -e "devtools::check()"

# Build and install
R CMD build .
R CMD INSTALL forecastdom_*.tar.gz

Architecture

Forecast Evaluation Tests (Exported)

Function Test Hypothesis Reference
dm_test() Diebold-Mariano (+ HLN correction) UEPA (pairwise) Diebold & Mariano (1995), Harvey et al. (1997)
cw_test() Clark-West MSFE-adjusted Nested model comparison Clark & West (2007)
enc_new() ENC-NEW encompassing Encompassing Clark & McCracken (2001)
cepa_test() Giacomini-White CEPA (conditional equal) Giacomini & White (2006)
uspa_test() Hansen’s SPA USPA (unconditional superior) Hansen (2005)
cspa_test() Li-Liao-Quaedvlieg CSPA (conditional superior) Li, Liao & Quaedvlieg (2022)
csms() Confidence Set for Most Superior Inverted CSPA Li, Liao & Quaedvlieg (2022)

Supporting Functions (Exported)

  • cspa_test_plot() — ggplot2 visualization of h_j(x), lower envelope, and confidence bound
  • do_sim() — Simulates data from the DGP in Section 3.1 of LLQ (2022)

Internal Helpers

  • covnw() — Newey-West (Bartlett kernel) long-run covariance estimator
  • get_legendre() — Legendre polynomial basis (up to order 11)
  • do_prewhiten() — VAR-based pre-whitening with AIC lag selection

S3 Classes

All test functions return S3 objects with print methods using a consistent rounded-box Unicode style. cspa_test also has a summary method with per-competitor diagnostics. Formatting helpers (.center_line, .padded_line, .kv_line) are in R/cspa_test.R.

CSPA Algorithm (Algorithm 1 from the paper)

  1. Series regression of Y on Legendre basis P(X) to estimate conditional means h_j(x)
  2. HAC covariance estimation (Newey-West or pre-whitened)
  3. Gaussian process simulation for critical values
  4. Adaptive inequality selection to remove clearly inferior (j, x) pairs
  5. Confidence bound construction — reject if theta < 0

Dependencies

  • MASS, stats, ggplot2 (runtime)
  • testthat (>= 3.0.0, testing only)
